title: done accepts the anchor rows a census run adds for the sources its census log records
goal: bl_land.unrelated_baselines counts an _anchors.csv row of a source as named when a census log row (a row of a csv under _census/) that the item's commits add or change records that source id, so a census item's goal need not list the ids; an anchor row of a source with no such census row is still refused

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, types
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_land
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t")
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=d, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
git("init", "-q")
os.makedirs(d + "/kb/public/_census")
head = "fact,path,source_id,status,heading,terms,sha,quote,verified_utc\n"
anchors, census = d + "/kb/public/_anchors.csv", d + "/kb/public/_census/2026-10-23.csv"
open(anchors, "w").write(head)
open(census, "w").write("id,url,outcome\nS903,https://example.com/c,OK\n")
git("add", "-A")
git("commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
rows = "".join(f"f{n},x/a.md,S{n},located,,,,,2026-10-23\n" for n in (901, 902, 903))
open(anchors, "a").write(rows)
open(census, "a").write("S901,https://example.com/a,OK\n")
git("add", "-A")
git("commit", "-q", "-m", "census run")
sha = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
paths = ["kb/public/_anchors.csv", "kb/public/_census/2026-10-23.csv"]
bl = types.SimpleNamespace(items={"ST-x": {"goal": "run the census", "title": "census"}}, descendants=lambda i: [])
refused = [s for s, w in bl_land.unrelated_baselines(bl, "ST-x", d, {sha: paths})]
print("anchor rows refused for", refused, "(want S902 and S903: only S901 has a census row the commit added)")
sys.exit(0 if refused == ["S902", "S903"] else 1)

clauses.clause: bl_land.unrelated_baselines counts an _anchors.csv row of a source as named when a census log row (a row of a csv under _census/) that the item's commits add or change records that source id, so a census item's goal need not list the ids
an anchor row of a source with no such census row is still refused

notes: Retrospective of SP-rmp5zm5a (2026-10-22, operator accepted): done refused ST-zpe7qxtv (186 sources) and ST-bjwyl2bc (100 sources) for anchor rows of sources the goal does not name; the manager dropped 357 anchor rows for the first and listed 100 ids in the second goal (TEXT_MAX 2000 limits that). The draft check reads source text; planning replaces it with a planted census item. Premise: the check builds a throwaway git repo with an _anchors.csv and a _census/ log, one item commit that adds anchor rows for S901, S902 and S903 and a census row for S901 only (S903's census row is older), and calls bl_land.unrelated_baselines with a goal that names no id. On main it prints: anchor rows refused for ['S901', 'S902', 'S903']. The fix reads the ids of census rows the commits add or change; the _census directory stays out of cited_tokens (the files cite no source of their own), so only anchor rows of those ids count as named.
